_comment: Scope for the formbook tree. The generated data/index.json maps CourtListener court ids to the checked-in folder tree. A court is ACTIVE if any `dates` entry in courts-db has end == null. Ids are CourtListener court ids; never invent ids for courts that exist in courts-db.

levels._comment: Level for explicitly allowed national/agency/military ids. Everything else is derived from the rules below.

state_supreme._comment: State courts of last resort get level state-supreme: name matches the regex, or id is listed. Everything else state-level is state-appellate.
